name: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel
positioning: Downtown Saigon hotel at the corner of Dong Khoi and Dong Du streets, within walking distance of the Opera House, with lotus-motif rooms and the Grand Opera Tower, a hotel within a hotel
best_for: City travelers who want to walk to the Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office
Guests who want a more private stay in the Grand Opera Tower with access to The Salon lounge

facts.text: High-end boutiques along Dong Khoi Street are a leisurely stroll from the hotel.
Room interiors draw inspiration from the Saigon Opera House.
Grand Opera Tower guests have access to The Salon, a private lounge with bespoke service, daily breakfast and seamless check-in and check-out.
Grand Opera Tower rooms blend Opera House-inspired design with Vietnamese craftsmanship.
Grand Opera Tower rooms include wireless charging stations and in-room garment steamers.
The Presidential Suite is on the 21st floor and has three bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathroom, plus dedicated butler service.
Club Lounge rooms and suites come with priority check-in, complimentary breakfast, evening cocktails and dedicated concierge services.
The concierge team helps arrange city tours and cultural experiences.
Rooms have ergonomic workstations and high-speed Wi-Fi.

highlights.text: Grand Opera Tower is a hotel within a hotel inside Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel.
The hotel rises above the intersection of Dong Khoi Street and Dong Du Street, with room views over Nguyen Hue Walking Street or the Saigon River.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office.
Select Grand Opera Tower rooms have views of the Saigon River and the historic Bason Bridge.
Rooms are decorated with lotus motifs celebrating Vietnam's national flower.

considerations.text: The hotel is minutes from major corporate offices, banks and the business district, and a metro station is nearby.
WhataHotel notes the busy downtown location comes with traffic noise.
